description: Flat metadata schema for individual records from experiments differentiating patient-derived induced pluripotent stem cells into neurons for neurodegenerative disease modeling and therapeutic testing.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual metadata record or experiment sample.

patient_id.descr: De-identified patient donor identifier for the original iPSC source.

cell_line_id.descr: Unique identifier for the iPSC line used in the experiment.

donor_age_years.descr: Age of the donor at sample collection, in years.

donor_sex.descr: Biological sex of the donor; expected values include male, female, intersex, or unknown.

disease_name.descr: Primary neurodegenerative disease modeled, e.g., Alzheimer's disease or Parkinson's disease.

disease_subtype.descr: Disease subtype or clinical classification, if available.

clinical_diagnosis.descr: Clinically documented diagnosis associated with the donor, if available.

genetic_variant_id.descr: Identifier(s) for the known pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant(s) present in the donor or cell line.

gene_symbol.descr: Gene symbol of the mutated gene, e.g., APP, PSEN1, SNCA, LRRK2, or MAPT.

variant_hgvs.descr: Variant description in HGVS format, if available.

variant_consequence.descr: Predicted or reported molecular consequence of the variant, e.g., missense, nonsense, frameshift, splice-site.

zygosity.descr: Zygosity of the reported variant; expected values include heterozygous, homozygous, hemizygous, or unknown.

iPSC_source_tissue.descr: Source tissue used to generate the iPSC line, e.g., skin fibroblast, peripheral blood mononuclear cell, or urine cell.

reprogramming_method.descr: Method used to generate the iPSC line, e.g., Sendai virus, episomal, retroviral, or mRNA-based reprogramming.

iPSC_passage_number.descr: Passage number of the iPSC culture at the start of differentiation.

karyotype_status.descr: Karyotype or chromosomal stability assessment of the iPSC line, if performed.

mycoplasma_status.descr: Mycoplasma test result for the culture, e.g., negative, positive, or not tested.

differentiation_batch_id.descr: Identifier for the differentiation batch or experimental run.

differentiation_protocol_name.descr: Name or version of the neuronal differentiation protocol used.

differentiation_protocol_type.descr: General protocol class, e.g., dual-SMAD inhibition, transcription factor-driven, small-molecule induction, or co-culture-based.

end_date.descr: Date when the neuronal differentiation endpoint was collected.

differentiation_duration_days.descr: Total duration of differentiation in days from initiation to collection.

growth_factors_used.descr: Growth factors, cytokines, or morphogens used during differentiation; provide as a controlled string list if multiple were used.

small_molecules_used.descr: Small molecules used during differentiation, if applicable; provide as a controlled string list if multiple were used.

media_composition.descr: Key media formulation or basal medium used during differentiation and neuronal maintenance.

timing_schedule.descr: Text description of major timing steps, including day-by-day additions, media changes, and withdrawal of factors.

culture_substrate.descr: Surface coating or extracellular matrix used for cell culture, e.g., Matrigel, laminin, poly-D-lysine/ornithine.

oxygen_condition.descr: Oxygen concentration during differentiation or maturation, expressed as descriptive string such as normoxia or hypoxia with percentage if known.

temperature_celsius.descr: Incubation temperature used for culture, in degrees Celsius.

co_culture_present.descr: Whether co-culture with astrocytes, neurons, or other supportive cells was used.

neuronal_subtype.descr: Resulting neuronal subtype, e.g., glutamatergic, dopaminergic, GABAergic, cholinergic, or mixed.

neuronal_maturation_stage.descr: Maturation stage at collection, e.g., progenitor, immature neuron, mature neuron, or day-specific stage.

cell_density_cells_per_cm2.descr: Seeding or harvest density in cells per square centimeter, if measured.

viability_percent.descr: Cell viability at collection, expressed as percent.

marker_expression_profile.descr: Key lineage or maturation markers measured, summarized as a string such as MAP2+, TUJ1+, TH+, SYN1+, or combinations.

qc_passed.descr: Whether the sample passed predefined quality-control criteria.

morphology_assessment.descr: Summary of neuronal morphology, e.g., neurite length, branching complexity, soma size, or abnormal morphology.

synaptic_activity_assessment.descr: Summary of synaptic activity readouts, e.g., spontaneous firing, calcium transients, MEA activity, or synapse density.

electrophysiology_summary.descr: Summary of electrophysiological properties if measured, e.g., action potential firing, resting membrane potential, or input resistance.

calcium_imaging_result.descr: Summary of calcium imaging phenotype if measured, including hyperactivity, hypoactivity, or normal response.

disease_phenotype_summary.descr: Observed disease-relevant cellular phenotype, e.g., protein aggregation, neurite shortening, oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, or none detected.

intervention_applied.descr: Whether a therapeutic or experimental intervention was applied to the differentiated neurons.

intervention_name.descr: Name of the drug, compound, gene perturbation, or treatment applied, if any.

intervention_dose.descr: Dose or concentration of the intervention, with units embedded in the string if needed, e.g., 10 uM or 50 ng/mL.

intervention_start_day.descr: Differentiation day on which the intervention was started, if applicable.

intervention_duration_days.descr: Duration of the intervention exposure in days, if applicable.

assay_method.descr: Primary assay used to quantify phenotype, e.g., immunocytochemistry, RNA-seq, patch clamp, MEA, qPCR, or ELISA.

assay_timepoint_day.descr: Differentiation day or culture age at which the assay was performed.

replicate_number.descr: Technical or biological replicate number for the record.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to the experimental record.
